title: Page catalog card
responsibility: Summarizes a page with its own recorded screenshot and verification.

inputs.name: ExplorerPageCard.row
inputs.description: Required page catalog facts including identity/name, summary, component count, changed flag and verdict.

inputs.name: ExplorerPageCard.shot
inputs.description: Required screenshot or null. Image appears only with nonmissing file and no load failure.

outputs.name: ExplorerPageCard
outputs.description: Linked page card with lazy screenshot or no-recorded-screenshot fallback, summary, component count, Changed badge and verdict. Provides Open page action. Image-load failure uses the same fallback as missing data. The 36-pixel arrow link keeps its Open page accessible name and hover tooltip.
